faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT(ISM) Dhanbad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment drive by IIT(ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech. in Mining or Civil Engineering, or an M.Sc./M.Sc. Tech./M.Tech. in relevant fields like Mining, Geotechnical Engineering, Geology, etc.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this JRF role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- along with admissible House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT(ISM) Dhanbad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application with all required documents to the email address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT(ISM) Dhanbad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad is located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, with the pincode 826004.
